title: Giswater PostgreSQL Roles
description_keycloak: Lists Keycloak users and shows their sync status with QWC and the Giswater data database. Manage PostgreSQL roles for users present in the database.
description_qwc2: Lists QWC users and shows their PostgreSQL sync status in the Giswater data database. Manage PostgreSQL roles for users present in the database.

users_help_keycloak: Users fetched from Keycloak. The QWC and PG columns show whether the user exists in the QWC config and in the Giswater PostgreSQL database. Schema, manager and Giswater roles can only be managed when the user exists in PostgreSQL.
